description: Build a single-elimination tournament bracket from any list of players or teams — automatic seeding, byes and round-by-round matchups.

faqs.a: Yes — the field is padded up to the next power of 2, and the extra slots become byes so top seeds advance automatically.
faqs.q: What if my player count is not a power of 2?

faqs.a: Tick the shuffle box to randomize seeds, or leave it off to keep your entry order as seeds 1, 2, 3...
Single elimination: lose once and you are out. The bracket shows every round through to the final.
Yes, everything is generated locally in your browser.

howto: Enter one player or team per line.
Choose whether to shuffle the seeds.
Press Build bracket to see every round from Round 1 to the Final.
title: Tournament Bracket Maker
